permissions.label: Answer a client's question from the visit, plan and invoice records
permissions.note: Only what the visit, plan and invoice records say. It never gives an arrival estimate the record doesn't have.

permissions.label: Acknowledge a client's request and ask only for what is missing or unclear
Tell a client what an existing invoice shows and send its secure payment link
permissions.note: The existing invoice's own link. Care never creates an invoice, marks one paid, refunds or charges.

permissions.label: Acknowledge a complaint and open or link the Quality and Retention cases (no findings, refunds or promises)
permissions.note: Opens or joins Retention's recovery case for the visit, which starts Quality's investigation. Care states no finding, refund or re-clean time.

permissions.label: Send a promised update about a request that is still being worked
Record a client's preference for one visit, a property or every future visit
permissions.note: A preference for one visit goes on that visit only. A standing one goes on the property or the client.

permissions.label: Replace a property's access instructions with what the client sent
permissions.note: Written to the property's restricted access field. The code never appears in notices, summaries or the activity.

permissions.label: Move one visit to a time Dispatch can cover, inside the change notice
permissions.note: Only times Dispatch's capacity check offers. Moving re-checks the time and the visit, then asks the crew again.

permissions.label: Skip a recurring visit, or cancel a one-time visit, inside the change notice
permissions.note: One visit only. The rest of a recurring series is unchanged.

permissions.label: Pause or end a recurring service at the client's request
permissions.note: Through Retention's plan-change code, for exactly the visits the client was shown. Retention is told; it never delays a cancellation.

permissions.label: Add a published extra to an upcoming visit at its current price, once the client accepts it
permissions.note: Care doesn't change a visit's price yet. It prepares the extra with its published price, and a person adds it to the visit.

permissions.label: Apply a late-change fee the client's agreement or Care Setup sets
permissions.note: Care never applies a fee. When your policy sets one, the request comes to you; Finance adds it if you decide to.

permissions.label: Hand a request to Sales, Dispatch, Quality, Retention or Finance
